### Advisory

- CHANGELOG says the transcript position must be 'the one its own session id and kind give', but the implementation only validates the position's shape (absolute path, int size >= 0, str/None last_uuid); the transcript path is not bound to the marker's session id. The module docstring is accurate; the changelog sentence overstates the validation. (severity: info)
- injections.jsonl grows without bound: nothing trims it (unlike trim_archive), yet read_injections and archived_handovers parse the whole file on every SessionStart and resume. (severity: info)
- The injection record is logged before emit; if emit raises after logging, the audit log records a delivered handover the model never received. State safety is unaffected (the claim stays resumable). (severity: info)
- An unrecognized rotate argument (not 'write'/'resume') silently does nothing, so a typo gives the user no feedback. (severity: info)
